mapper.select:
select fsr.SCORE_RESULT_ID, fsr.SCORE_TEMPLATE_HD_ID, fsr.GREAD_DATE, fsr.RESULT_ID, fsr.IS_TURN_UP, fsr.bp_id, (select hbm.BP_NAME from hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.BP_ID = fsr.BP_ID) BP_NAME_N,
(select fsth.SCORE_TEMPLATE_HD_NAME value_name from fnd_score_template_hd fsth where fsth.SCORE_TEMPLATE_HD_ID = fsr.SCORE_TEMPLATE_HD_ID) SCORE_TEMPLATE_HD_ID_N,
( select hfsh.FISCAL_YEAR value_name from hls_fin_statement_hd hfsh where hfsh.FIN_STATEMENT_HD_ID = fsr.FISCAL_YEAR ) FISCAL_YEAR_N,
( select hfsh.FISCAL_MONTH value_name from hls_fin_statement_hd hfsh where hfsh.FIN_STATEMENT_HD_ID = fsr.FISCAL_MONTH ) FISCAL_MONTH_N,
( SELECT hr.FIN_STATEMENT_NAME FROM hls_bp_financial_header h, hls_web_excel_calc_result hr, hls_web_excel hwe WHERE h.header_id = hr.source_document_id AND hr.source_document_category = 'FINANCIAL_REPORT' AND hwe.excel_id = hr.excel_id and hr.RESULT_ID = fsr.RESULT_ID AND h.bp_id = fsr.bp_id ) RESULT_ID_N,
(select scvb.MEANING value_name FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scvb where scb.CODE_ID = scvb.CODE_ID and scb.CODE = 'GRADE.IS_TURN_UP' and scvb.VALUE = fsr.IS_TURN_UP) IS_TURN_UP_N
from fnd_score_result fsr
fsr.bp_id = #{bpId}
and fsr.SCORE_RESULT_ID = #{scoreResultId}
